// Private synthetic host. Copied beside a fresh generated P04 package, never
// compiled in the archive store and never a public app-kit runtime API.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	_ "embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"example.invalid/appkit-directory-journey/converted"
	journey "example.invalid/appkit-directory-journey/journey"
)

//go:embed app.css
var css []byte

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "--dataset" {
		if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
			Revision string
			Rows []journey.Row
		}{journey.DatasetRevision(), journey.Rows()}); err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) != 1 { log.Fatal("no host arguments accepted") }
	h, err := journey.NewHandler(func(ctx context.Context, view journey.View) ([]byte, error) {
		data := converted.Directory{
			Heading: view.Heading, Introduction: view.Introduction,
			AddLabel: view.AddLabel, AddURL: view.AddURL, EditLabel: view.EditLabel,
			NameLabel: "Name", TitleLabel: "Title", EmailLabel: "Email", RoleLabel: "Role",
		}
		if len(view.Rows) != len(view.DetailURLs) { return nil, fmt.Errorf("row/destination mismatch") }
		for i, row := range view.Rows {
			data.Rows = append(data.Rows, converted.DirectoryRow{
				Name: row.Name, Title: row.Title, Email: row.Email, Role: row.Role, EditURL: view.DetailURLs[i],
			})
		}
		component, err := converted.NewDirectoryEnhanced(data)
		if err != nil { return nil, err }
		var body bytes.Buffer
		if err := component.Render(ctx, &body); err != nil { return nil, err }
		return body.Bytes(), nil
	}, css)
	if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	srv := &http.Server{Handler: h, ReadHeaderTimeout: 5*time.Second}
	served := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { served <- srv.Serve(listener) }()
	fmt.Printf("directory-journey → http://%s\n", listener.Addr())
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
	case err = <-served:
		if err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed { log.Fatal(err) }
		return
	}
	shutdown, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := srv.Shutdown(shutdown); err != nil { _ = srv.Close(); log.Fatal(err) }
	if err := <-served; err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed { log.Fatal(err) }
}
